title: Films, music, sport & free time
goal: Talk about films, series, music and sport, recommend or pan something, argue about the best team and player, and talk about your hobbies — comparing things in detail.
intro:
Cricket is close to a religion in eastern Afghanistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa; Turkish and Indian dramas are on every TV in the evening; Pashto pop and the old rabab masters play in every taxi. Talk about any of these and a conversation starts by itself.

This unit takes **comparison** further than unit 8: 'much better', 'as good as', 'one of the best', 'the best I've ever seen', 'the more you practise, the better you get' and 'so good that …'.

grammar.title: Much better, a bit worse, as good as
grammar.body:
Unit 8 gave you the basic comparison: **X تر Y + adjective** — زه **تر** تا لوړ يم 'I'm taller than you'. There is no '-er' ending; the adjective stays in its plain form and **agrees with X**, not with Y: دا لړۍ تر هغې **اوږده** ده (لړۍ is feminine), دا فلم تر هغې لړۍ **اوږد** دی. After تر, pronouns are oblique: تر **ما**، تر **تا**، تر **هغه / هغې**، تر **موږ**.

**How much more:** put **ډېر** 'much' or **لږ** 'a little' before the adjective: تر هغه **ډېر** ښه 'much better than him', تر پخوا **لږ** بې خونده 'a bit more boring than before'. 'Better and better / every day': **ورځ په ورځ** ښه کېږي.

**'As … as', 'like':** **غوندې** comes **after** the noun or pronoun: ستا **غوندې** 'like you', هغه هم د پلار **غوندې** مشهور دی 'he's as famous as his father'. The same meaning: **د X په څېر** or **لکه X**.

**'Not as … as':** just negate the verb: زه ستا غوندې ښې سندرې **نه** شم ويلای 'I can't sing as well as you'.

**'The same':** **يو شان**: دواړه **يو شان** ښه دي 'they're equally good'.

**The trap:** don't look for a word for 'more' with adjectives. **زيات** / **ډېر** before the adjective mean 'much / very', not '-er': تر هغه **ډېر ښه** = 'much better than him'; the 'than' is carried by تر.

grammar.title: The best, one of the best, the best ever
grammar.body:
**The best:** **تر ټولو** + adjective (lit. 'than all'), again with agreement: **تر ټولو** ښه لوبغاړی 'the best player', **تر ټولو** مشهوره لوبه 'the most popular game'. 'In the world / in Afghanistan' is simply د نړۍ / د افغانستان or په … کې: د نړۍ تر ټولو ښه لوبغاړی.

**One of the best:** **له + oblique plural + څخه + يو / يوه**: د نړۍ **له** ښو لوبغاړو **څخه يو** 'one of the best players in the world'. The noun and adjective take the oblique plural **-o** (ښو لوبغاړو, ښو لوبډلو), and **يو / يوه** agrees with the noun: لوبغاړی (m) → **يو**, لوبډله (f) → **يوه**. In speech, نه often replaces څخه: له ښو لوبغاړو **نه** يو.

**The best … I've ever …:** use a relative clause with **تر اوسه** 'so far': دا **تر ټولو** ښه لوبه وه چې ما **تر اوسه** ليدلې ده 'that was the best match I've ever seen'.

**The most** (amount) with a noun: تر ټولو **ډېرې** منډې 'the most runs'.

**The trap:** with 'one of', don't forget the agreement of يو / يوه: لوبډله is feminine, so … څخه **يوه** ده.

examples.en: Rashid Khan is one of the best players in the world.

examples.en: That's the most boring film I've ever seen.

grammar.title: The more …, the more … · so … that …
grammar.body:
**The more …, the more …:** Pashto pairs the question word **څومره** 'how much' with **هومره** 'that much':

**څومره چې** + clause 1، **هومره** + clause 2
څومره چې ډېر تمرين کوې، هومره ښه کېږې 'the more you practise, the better you get' (lit. as much as you practise a lot, that much you become good)

Put ډېر / ښه / ژر etc. in **both** halves to say what increases. It works in any tense: څومره چې مې ډېر وکوت، هومره مې ډېر خوښ شو 'the more I watched, the more I liked it'. A favourite short form: **څومره چې ژر، هومره ښه** 'the sooner the better'.

**However much …:** **هر څومره چې** … خو بيا هم … 'however much …, still …'.

**So … that …:** **دومره** + adjective/adverb + … **چې** + result: فلم **دومره** په زړه پورې و **چې** دوه ځله مې وکوت 'the film was so good that I watched it twice'.

**The trap:** don't mix the pairs: **څومره … هومره** go together (the more … the more); **دومره … چې** go together (so … that).

culture:
Cricket came to Afghanistan with refugees who grew up in the camps around Peshawar, and the national team's rise is a huge source of pride: when Afghanistan wins, people dance the **اتڼ** in the streets of Jalalabad and Kabul. Matches against Pakistan are especially heated — banter is fine among friends, but keep it light with people you don't know. Football is growing fast too, and **بزکشي** (buzkashi, horsemen fighting over a goat carcass) is the traditional spectator sport of the north.

On TV, dubbed Turkish and Indian dramas are family viewing. In music, the **رباب** is the national instrument; older people love classic singers such as Ahmad Zahir and Pashto ghazal singers, young people Pashto pop and wedding songs. Kite-flying (**پتنګ بازي**) on the flat roofs is a Friday tradition for boys, and a **جمعه** picnic in Paghman or by the river is the classic family outing. Asking **ستا شوق څه دی؟** 'what are you into?' is an easy way to make friends.

tip.title: Saying what you thought
tip.body:
- Good: **عالي** 'brilliant', **په زړه پورې** 'gripping', **ارزښت يې لري** 'worth it'.
- Bad: **بې خونده** 'boring', young people's **بور شوم** 'I got bored'.
- These are invariable: عالي فلم، عالي لړۍ.

lessons.title: Cricket: the best team, the best player

tip.title: The best, one of the best
tip.body:
- **تر ټولو** + adjective = the best / most: تر ټولو ښه لوبغاړی.
- One of: **له** ښو لوبډلو **څخه يوه** — oblique plural -o, and يو / يوه agrees.
- Ever: … چې ما **تر اوسه** ليدلې ده.

sentences.roman: haġə́ pə de lóba ke tər ṭolo ḍére mánḍe jóṛe kṛe.
sentences.en: He scored the most runs in this match.

sentences.native: دا تر ټولو ښه لوبه وه چې ما تر اوسه ليدلې ده.
sentences.roman: dā tər ṭolo ṣa lóba wa che mā tər ósa lidə́le da.
sentences.en: That's the best match I've ever seen.

sentences.native: زه د افغان لوبډلې ملاتړ کوم.
sentences.roman: zə də afġā́n lobḍə́le malātáṛ kawə́m.
sentences.en: I support the Afghan team.

sentences.native: مينه‌والو ټوله شپه ګډا وکړه.
sentences.roman: minawā́lo ṭóla shpa gaḍā́ wə́kṛa.
sentences.en: The fans danced all night.

sentences.native: پاکستان په لسو منډو وګټله.
sentences.roman: pākistā́n pə lasó manḍó wə́gaṭəla.
sentences.en: Pakistan won by ten runs.

sentences.native: هغه د نړۍ له مشهورو لوبغاړو څخه يو دی.
sentences.roman: haġá də naṛə́y la mashhúro lobġā́ṛo tsəxa yaw day.
sentences.en: He's one of the most famous players in the world.

sentences.native: نن د فوټبال سيالي ده، راځې؟
sentences.roman: nən də fuṭbā́l siyālí da, rā́dze?
sentences.en: There's a football match today — are you coming?

sentences.native: سيالي په کوم لوبغالي کې ده؟
sentences.roman: siyālí pə kum lobġā́li ke da?
sentences.en: Which stadium is the match at?

sentences.native: لوبغالی ډک و!
sentences.roman: lobġā́lay ḍak wə!
sentences.en: The stadium was packed!

sentences.native: څو ګولونه يې ووهل؟
sentences.roman: tso golúna ye wə́wahəl?
sentences.en: How many goals did they score?

sentences.native: يوازې يو ګول يې ووهه.
sentences.roman: yawā́ze yaw gol ye wə́waha.
sentences.en: They only scored one goal.

sentences.native: لوبه يو يو مساوي شوه.
sentences.roman: lóba yaw yaw musāwí shwa.
sentences.en: The match was a one-all draw.

sentences.native: زما ورور تر کرکټ فوټبال ډېر خوښوي.
sentences.roman: zmā wror tər krikáṭ fuṭbā́l ḍer xwaṣawí.
sentences.en: My brother likes football more than cricket.

sentences.native: ګول! څه عالي ګول و!
sentences.roman: gol! tsə ālí gol wə!
sentences.en: Goal! What a goal!

sentences.native: د دې کال اتل څوک دی؟
sentences.roman: də de kāl atál tsok day?
sentences.en: Who's this year's champion?

sentences.native: راځه، لوبغالي ته ځو چې خپله لوبډله وهڅوو.
sentences.roman: rā́dza, lobġā́li ta dzu che xpə́la lobḍə́la wə́hatsawu.
sentences.en: Come on, let's go to the stadium and cheer on our team.

sentences.native: ستا لوبډلې وګټله که مساوي شوه؟
sentences.roman: stā lobḍə́le wə́gaṭəla ka musāwí shwa?
sentences.en: Did your team win or draw?

lessons.title: The more you practise …

tip.title: The more …, the more … · so … that …
tip.body:
- **څومره چې** …، **هومره** …: څومره چې ډېر تمرين کوې، هومره ښه کېږې.
- **دومره** … **چې** … 'so … that …': دومره ستړی وم چې …
- Don't mix them: څومره ↔ هومره, دومره ↔ چې.

new: څومره چې ډېر تمرين کوې، هومره ښه کېږې.

sentences.native: څومره چې ډېر ورزش کوې، هومره ښه خوب کوې.
sentences.roman: tsómra che ḍer warzísh kawé, hómra ṣə xob kawé.
sentences.en: The more you exercise, the better you sleep.

sentences.native: څومره چې ژر پاڅېږې، هومره ډېر وخت لرې.
sentences.roman: tsómra che zhər pātséẓe, hómra ḍer waxt lare.
sentences.en: The earlier you get up, the more time you have.

sentences.native: فلم دومره په زړه پورې و چې دوه ځله مې وکوت.
sentences.roman: film dómra pə zṛə póre wə che dwa dzə́la me wə́kot.
sentences.en: The film was so good I watched it twice.

sentences.native: دومره ستړی وم چې ورزش ته لاړ نه شوم.
sentences.roman: dómra stə́ṛay wəm che warzísh ta lāṛ na shwəm.
sentences.en: I was so tired I couldn't go and work out.

sentences.native: څومره چې عمر زياتېږي، هومره ورزش سخت کېږي.
sentences.roman: tsómra che ʿumr ziyātéẓi, hómra warzísh saxt kéẓi.
sentences.en: The older you get, the harder exercise gets.

sentences.native: هر څومره چې تمرين کوم، خو بيا هم بايلم.
sentences.roman: har tsómra che tamrín kawə́m, xo biyā́ ham bāyləm.
sentences.en: However much I practise, I still lose.

sentences.native: هره ورځ تمرين کوې؟
sentences.roman: hára wradz tamrín kawé?
sentences.en: Do you practise every day?

sentences.native: هو، په اوونۍ کې درې ځله ورزش کوم.
sentences.roman: ho, pə owənə́y ke dre dzə́la warzísh kawə́m.
sentences.en: Yes, I work out three times a week.

sentences.native: ډاکټر راته وويل چې ډېر ورزش وکړه.
sentences.roman: ḍākṭár rā́ta wə́wayəl che ḍer warzísh wə́kṛa.
sentences.en: The doctor told me to exercise more.

lessons.title: Hobbies and days out
new: ارزښت يې لري، خامخا يې وګوره.
په وزګار وخت کې څه کوې؟

sentences.native: ستا شوق څه دی؟
sentences.roman: stā shawq tsə day?
sentences.en: What are you into? / What are your hobbies?

sentences.native: زه د لامبو شوق لرم.
sentences.roman: zə də lāmbó shawq lárəm.
sentences.en: I'm really into swimming.

sentences.native: په اوړي کې په سيند کې لامبو وهو.
sentences.roman: pə oṛí ke pə sind ke lāmbó wahú.
sentences.en: In summer we swim in the river.

sentences.native: د جمعې په ورځ پتنګ الوزوو.
sentences.roman: də jumʿé pə wradz patáng alwazawú.
sentences.en: On Fridays we fly kites.

sentences.native: دا يوازې د تفريح لپاره دی.
sentences.roman: dā yawā́ze də tafríh lapā́ra day.
sentences.en: It's just for fun.

sentences.native: د جمعې په ورځ د تفريح لپاره پغمان ته ځو.
sentences.roman: də jumʿé pə wradz də tafríh lapā́ra paġmā́n ta dzu.
sentences.en: On Fridays we go to Paghman for a day out.

sentences.native: دا کتاب ډېر په زړه پورې دی، خامخا يې ولوله.
sentences.roman: dā kitā́b ḍer pə zṛə póre day, xāmaxā́ ye wə́lwala.
sentences.en: This book is really gripping — you have to read it.

sentences.native: ټکټ ګران دی، خو ارزښت لري.
sentences.roman: ṭikáṭ grān day, xo arzə́ṣt lári.
sentences.en: The ticket's expensive, but it's worth it.

sentences.native: په وزګار وخت کې له ملګرو سره ګرځم.
sentences.roman: pə wazgā́r waxt ke la malgə́ro sara gə́rdzəm.
sentences.en: In my free time I hang out with friends.
